story_info.title: Barnaby Bunny's Calm Night
story_info.subtitle: Finding Peace Before Sleep
story_info.moral: Thinking of happy memories and friends can help you relax before sleep.

main_character.name: Barnaby Bunny
main_character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.

cover.visual_action: Barnaby Bunny sitting peacefully, looking calm

slides.title: A Tiny Wiggle
slides.text: Barnaby Bunny felt a tiny wiggle inside. It was almost bedtime. Barnaby was not feeling sleepy. He wanted to feel calm and ready to dream. 'How can I find peace?' he thought. He looked at his cozy bed. He wanted a soft feeling.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is in his room, looking at his bed, feeling restless.

slides.title: A Quiet Walk
slides.text: Barnaby decided to go for a quiet walk. Moonlight Meadow was his favorite place. The evening air felt cool. It felt soft on his nose. Barnaby hopped gently on the path. He looked at the tall grass. He looked at the sleeping flowers.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is gently hopping through Moonlight Meadow at dusk.

slides.title: Happy Firefly Friend
slides.text: Suddenly, a little light danced by. It was a happy firefly! It reminded Barnaby of Pip the Squirrel. Pip loved to play hide-and-seek. Barnaby smiled softly at the memory. Thinking of friends made his heart happy. It made his heart feel light.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby sees a firefly, which sparks a memory of Pip.

slides.title: Cloud and Carrots
slides.text: Next, Barnaby looked up. He saw a big, fluffy cloud. It floated slowly in the night sky. This cloud made him think of Bella Bear. Bella loved to share juicy carrots. Barnaby felt warm. He felt thankful inside his chest.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby looks at a cloud and thinks of Bella Bear.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams Begin
slides.text: Barnaby found a very comfy spot. He lay down on the soft grass. He closed his round, sleepy eyes. He thought of all his kind friends. He remembered their happy smiles. He remembered gentle hugs. He felt very calm now. 'Sweet dreams begin with a smile!' he whispered.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby lies down in the meadow, feeling peaceful and ready for sleep.
